title: In Splunk AI Assistant versions below 2.0.0 a user who does not hold the "admin" or "power" Splunk roles could access…
description: Splunk AI Assistant versions below 2.0.0 contain a vulnerability where users without admin or power roles can access data from other tenants and perform actions attributed to those tenants via the REST API. This occurs because the software accepts a client-controlled tenant identifier for authorization context selection.
